value.rationale: A balanced one-step transition rule is a mathematically natural singular boundary of prior local-curvature criteria. The first nonzero effective-speed term is fourth order and factors into site variance times skewness, with a strictly absent fifth-order correction and rigorous uniform remainder. This demonstrates a directional memory effect and solves a natural sign question beyond the directly available second-order theory.
